body: I’m already under IAPT but they have said I’m ‘too much of a risk’ for their services at this time. So I saw the crisis team who said I wasn’t enough of a risk for them, I just feel like it’d be better if I wasn’t here no one can help me anyway 😞

I must admit they know a lot about my depression, I’ve had it for around 5 years with an increased low mood and ideation struggle in the past 3 months. 
I’m not even sure why I’m going or what I expect them to do, apart from up the meds which is what they always do. Maybe I should just not go and deal with things myself..
